text:
Maria L: Heads-up, I opened a PR to consolidate kv-prefetch recommendations into the Optimize toolkit page and add a tiny JS example combining batching + 4-bit quant for short sequences. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/342

Devin P: Saw it. The example uses the old client factory signature; we need to update to the new RequestOptions param (small API change).

Maria L: Cool. I left a note in the PR. Also added a table comparing q4_0 vs q4_K but it reads a bit fuzzy about latency vs throughput. Would like a short "when to use" blurb.

Sasha M: I can validate numbers on our microbench infra. Questions: for short sequences (<32 tokens) should the docs recommend lowering max_batch and using a shorter aggregation window? Also, need to ensure we call out KV prefetch hit rate effects when batch sizes vary.

Maria L: Proposed copy: "For latency-sensitive short requests (<=32 tokens): prefer small batches (max_batch 10-4) and q4_0 for lowest latency. For throughput-oriented workloads, increase batch size and prefer q4_K for denser memory utilization." Will we be able to cite concrete p50/p95 numbers?

Kyle R: I'll run tests on T4 and A10 and post results tonight (cmds + minimal flamegraphs). Found two broken anchors in the migration guide; I'll open a tiny PR to fix those too.

Devin P: SDK patch is trivial. Once Kyle posts benches, I'll update the JS snippet to newClient({ requestOptions: ... }) and normalize the code style.

Maria L: UX items: add a short note under the quant table summarizing tradeoffs, and a one-paragraph note near the batching section about the cache-hit vs batch-size tradeoff for prefetched KV. Keeps readers from assuming bigger batches always win.

Sasha M: Also propose adding a quick reproducibility snippet for the microbench (curl + simple script) so docs readers can try the same knobs.

docs-bot: Reminder: docs PRs need >=1 eng + 1 docs reviewer. Label: needs-eng-review.

Maria L: Action list: (1) Kyle: bench logs + link-fix PR, (2) Sasha: validate latency/throughput recommendations and suggest default max_batch/agg_window, (3) Devin: update SDK snippet once benches land. I'll rebase and request final review after. Thanks :rocket:
